title: Shelf slots and display space
summary: A shelf in Supermarket Simulator is not one open surface: the game divides it into rack slots and display slots, tracks each one by index, and gives some displays a rule about what may be placed on them.
body: A shelf is made of slots. The game keeps a shelf as a set of rack slots with records of their own, which is why stocking a shelf is a slot-by-slot job rather than one shared pile of goods.
Every slot has an address. Slots carry an index and identifiers of their own, so the game can tell a shelf that is half full from one that is empty and one that is full.
Boxes are tied to slots as well. A box standing on a shelf is tracked against a slot, which is why a delivery left on the shelf is a different situation from stock sitting in the back room.

Displays are not the same thing as shelves. The game keeps display slots apart from rack slots, with their own indices, so a display case and a shelf are handled by different parts of the same system.
Some displays are built for one product. There are display slots made for ice cream cones and for ice cream flavours, which is why a freezer display is not interchangeable with a general shelf.
Displays can carry rules too. A display slot can have a condition attached about what may be placed in it, so the game is able to refuse a product that does not belong there.
What this entry does not tell you: how many slots a shelf has, how much a slot holds, or how many display types exist. We have not verified those numbers, so we do not print them.

facts.claim: A shelf is made of rack slots with records of their own.
Each slot carries an index and its own identifiers.
A box on a shelf is tracked against a slot as well.
Display slots are tracked apart from rack slots.
Some display slots are built for a particular product, including ice cream cones and flavours.
A display slot can carry a condition on what may be placed in it.
Further display pieces are named, including a pegboard display slot and a double-width bakery display.
facts.evidence: asset names: Display Slot (PegBoard) Variant, SM_BakeryDlc_L3_Display_Double

facts.claim: Display slots are named per appliance as well, with a freezer and a fridge variant among them.
facts.evidence: asset names: Display Slot (Freezer), Display Slot (Fridge)

facts.claim: A display slot is named for a garment rack as well as for the other fittings.
